tools.name: shopboss_list_appointments
tools.description: Review appointments, scheduled dates, customer and vehicle references. Dates use YYYY-MM-DD. Read-only. Resource permissions depend on your Shop Boss API key.

tools.name: shopboss_list_customers
tools.description: Find customers by ID, name, email or phone and review their contact and account context. Read-only. Resource permissions depend on your Shop Boss API key.

tools.name: shopboss_list_vehicles
tools.description: Find vehicles by ID, owner, VIN, make, model or year. Read-only. Resource permissions depend on your Shop Boss API key.

tools.name: shopboss_list_repair_orders
tools.description: Review repair orders with customer, vehicle, complaint and status context. Filter by order ID, customer or VIN. Read-only. Resource permissions depend on your Shop Boss API key.

tools.name: shopboss_list_order_parts
tools.description: Review parts, quantities, prices and ordering context associated with repair orders. Read-only. Resource permissions depend on your Shop Boss API key.

tools.name: shopboss_list_parts
tools.description: Review inventory availability, reorder levels and part details. Read-only. Resource permissions depend on your Shop Boss API key.

tools.name: shopboss_list_part_sales
tools.description: Review part-sale balances and statuses without taking payments or changing sales. Part-sale IDs may be negative, as shown in the vendor reference. Read-only. Resource permissions depend on your Shop Boss API key.

tools.name: shopboss_list_recommended_repairs
tools.description: Review recommended or previously declined work for a customer or vehicle. Read-only. Resource permissions depend on your Shop Boss API key.

tools.name: shopboss_list_canned_jobs
tools.description: Look up predefined automotive services and their pricing context. Read-only. Resource permissions depend on your Shop Boss API key.

tools.name: shopboss_list_employees
tools.description: Look up employee names, job descriptions, mechanic numbers and active status. Payroll, home addresses and emergency contacts are omitted. Read-only. Resource permissions depend on your Shop Boss API key.

tools.name: shopboss_list_suppliers
tools.description: Review supplier contact details and terms; account numbers are omitted. Read-only. Resource permissions depend on your Shop Boss API key.

tools.name: shopboss_list_bays
tools.description: List available service bays for appointment planning. Read-only. Resource permissions depend on your Shop Boss API key.

tools.name: shopboss_list_complaint_categories
tools.description: Look up the shop's repair complaint categories. Read-only. Resource permissions depend on your Shop Boss API key.

tools.name: shopboss_list_shop_hours
tools.description: Review the shop's configured opening and closing hours. Read-only. Resource permissions depend on your Shop Boss API key.

tools.name: shopboss_list_sources
tools.description: Review the shop's configured customer and appointment source labels. Read-only. Resource permissions depend on your Shop Boss API key.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: shopboss_list_appointments, shopboss_list_customers, shopboss_list_repair_orders, shopboss_list_order_parts, shopboss_list_parts, shopboss_list_part_sales, shopboss_list_recommended_repairs, shopboss_list_suppliers, shopboss_list_shop_hours, shopboss_list_sources · Private data: shopboss_list_appointments, shopboss_list_customers, shopboss_list_vehicles, shopboss_list_repair_orders, shopboss_list_order_parts, shopboss_list_parts, shopboss_list_part_sales, shopboss_list_recommended_repairs, shopboss_list_canned_jobs, shopboss_list_employees, shopboss_list_suppliers, shopboss_list_bays, shopboss_list_complaint_categories, shopboss_list_shop_hours, shopboss_list_sources · Public sink: shopboss_list_customers.

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
